outputs.summary_en: A social media post claims that Prime Minister Modi is offering all Indians 3 months of free mobile recharge. It instructs users to click a link to avail the offer, stating it is only valid until today.

claims.claim_original: प्रधानमंत्री मोदी सभी भारतीयों को 3 महीने का मुफ्त मोबाइल रिचार्ज दे रहे हैं।
claims.claim_en: Prime Minister Modi is giving all Indians 3 months of free mobile recharge.

extra_claims_not_checked: The offer is only valid until today.
